articles.title: Man sieht einen Feuerball, eine Rauchwolke. Der Roboter fährt einfach weiter
articles.teaser: Überall in der Ukraine laufen Fabriken auf Hochtouren, um Zehntausende neue Bodenroboter zu bauen. Die Fahrzeuge liefern Nachschub an die Front, bringen verletzte Soldaten zurück und haben laut Kiew bereits russische Stellungen einnehmen können. Doch sie haben eine Schwachstelle.
articles.image_title: Ukraines fight against the Russian invasion of its territory is almost about to enter its fifth year - with hundreds of thousands of lives lost in brutal warfare. The latest technological innovations from the Ukrainian side aim to fight the war remotely - by deploying robotic tank-style vehicles that can fight alongside infantry on the front line. A Ukrainian defence technology firm, DevDroid, says it intends to develop an unmanned ground combat system fitted with a 30mm cannon  a level of firepower that would mark a significant escalation in the role of combat robots in the war. DevDroids chief executive, Yurii Poritskyi, told Ukrainian defence outlet Militarnyi that the system is expected to operate effectively at ranges of up to four to five kilometres. That would place it well beyond the capabilities of earlier generations of Ukrainian ground robots, which have largely been used for reconnaissance, logistics and limited strike missions. Formal development of the new platform is due to begin in 2026, starting with detailed technical specifications. But Poritskyi acknowledged that mounting a 30mm cannon on a robotic vehicle presents major engineering challenges. The key issue is recoil, he said, noting that a cannon of this calibre generates far greater force than the lighter weapons previously fitted to robots. DevDroid envisages the future robot as both an assault system and a frontline support platform, operating alongside infantry units. Its role would include providing direct fire during attacks and helping to protect troops in high-threat environments where human soldiers are most at risk. If realised, analysts say the project would be among the most ambitious examples yet of Ukraines rapid shift towards unmanned ground systems  moving decisively from support roles towards heavily armed combat platforms. articles.title: Großbritanniens politisches System ist am Ende
articles.teaser: Zehn Jahre nach dem EU-Austritt hat sich die Spaltung in Großbritannien vertieft. Gleichzeitig hat der Brexit das politische System des Landes tiefgreifend verändert. Doch die Institutionen sind darauf nicht vorbereitet. Die Folgen sind enorm.
